card.name: Wash instructions after accidental skin contact
card.fires_on: Action verbs like wash, clean, rinse or remove that start a cleanup instruction after accidental skin, eye or mucous membrane contact with a drug. Also fires once on "in" before "the differential diagnosis" in a cough warning.
